data.one_liner: Get package info, Apple Store version details, and manage Android in-app updates.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to retrieve package information like app name, version, and build number. It also supports fetching version information from the Apple Store on iOS and managing in-app updates on Android.
use_when: You need to fetch package and version metadata on Android and iOS.
You need to implement Android in-app updates (flexible or immediate flows).
You need to check Apple Store version info and review status for iOS apps.
avoid_when: You require in-app updates on platforms other than Android.
You are looking for state management or backend services.
strengths: Supports both Android in-app updates and iOS App Store version lookup.
Provides clear error handling for Android in-app updates via InAppUpdateException.
weaknesses: In-app updates are restricted to Android 5.0+ and mobile/tablet/ChromeOS devices.
iOS store lookup requires correct region code and store availability configuration.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the dependency to pubspec.yaml. Android in-app updates depend on Google Play Core libraries.
